name: Requiem: Possessed Grin
description: The ultimate Requiem addon, inspired by The Exorcist. You are the demon. Possession takes hold in three stages, and the body shows it: flickering white eyes, a malicious grin and fangs, blood and bruises, then it rots while you wear it, down to bone and a skull for a face. The trapped soul pleads; every creature answers you in its own voice; lie in the soul's voice or a lost mother's. Powers: levitation, telekinesis, the head turn, bile, poltergeist fury, telepathy, the spider-walk, the body jump and your true face. Knocking walls, attic footsteps, shaking beds, an Ouija board the villagers ask and you answer, an ancient idol, holy water, and a full rite of exorcism with an old priest who comes out of the fog, faith you can break, and a young priest who offers himself. Possess the Warden, Wither and Ender Dragon.
